status.title: Account status
status.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this account? The member is signed out of member pages and notified by email.
status.notSelf: You can't change your own account status here. Use Settings instead.
status.noActions: Status changes for accounts under review are made on the Verification screen.

admin.title: Admin rights
admin.notAdmin: This member is not an admin.
admin.grantConfirm: Give this member full admin access, including private member data?
admin.revokeSelfConfirm: Remove your own admin rights? You will lose access to the admin area immediately.
admin.lastAdmin: There must always be at least one active admin.
admin.mustBeActive: Only active members can be made admins.

merge.title: Merge duplicate account
merge.description: If this person has two accounts, merge them into one. Sign-in methods, LINE, roles, follows, RSVPs and family links move to the kept account; the other account is deleted.
merge.otherHint: Find the ID on the other member's page.
merge.whatHappens: Empty profile fields on the kept account are filled from the other one. Where both have the same role, the kept account's details win. This cannot be undone.
merge.notFound: No account found with that ID or email.
merge.notSelf: You can't merge away your own account.
merge.keepsManaged: Keep the account the member signs in to; a parent-managed account can't absorb it.

bypassHint.keepsManaged: Keeps the parent-managed account and moves the member's sign-in methods to it. The parent no longer manages it (as after a handover).

deactivated.subject: Your AIS Alumni account was deactivated
deactivated.text: Your AIS Alumni account has been deactivated by the committee. If you think this is a mistake, please reply to this email or contact the committee.

reactivated.subject: Your AIS Alumni account is active again
reactivated.text: Welcome back! Your AIS Alumni account has been reactivated.

descriptions.TEACHER_MANAGER: Can send notifications to all members, selected roles or any class (up to 20 per day).
descriptions.STUDENT_LEADER: Represents their own class: joins the class reps chat and is the contact for their class. You can also manage class reps per class on the Classes page.
descriptions.TEACHER_REGISTRAR: Can mark members as current teachers or move them to former (Admin mode → Teachers). Current teachers can see children's profiles, so grant this only to someone you trust.
descriptions.ALUMNI_COMMITTEE: Can post news to any members. Each post goes out after another alumni committee member (or an admin) approves it.

requires.STUDENT_LEADER: Requires a current or former student role.
requires.ALUMNI_COMMITTEE: Requires a student or parent role.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.

errors.ownCohort: A class rep must be a student or graduate of that class (their own class).
